🤖 `state-fp:b123683ec476` — deterministic scan dispatching a `ci-red` unit at 2026-08-31T06:00:00Z.

Machine-readable debounce marker (homelab#198), written by `agents/coordinator-scan.sh`, not by the session that follows. It hashes the state that ride reads — head sha, every check's conclusion, `reviewDecision`, and the newest verdict's timestamp. For ci-red clauses (homelab#1108) each check's `startedAt` is also folded in, so a CI rerun changes the hash and re-arms the gate. While the hash is unchanged this clause emits a report line instead of another unit, so an escalation waiting on a human costs no further rides; any real movement on this PR changes it and the clause re-arms by itself.

<!-- agent-summary -->
🤖 **Agent activity** — one machine comment per timeline, appended in place (ADR-103). Run detail lives in the `agent-ride` check-run, the ledger and `s3://agent-transcripts/`; this is the index.
